escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.hint: The escalation stages with their names, their rules and their actions. The deadline of a stage is the waiting time per priority; rules and their actions fire in list order. Change the order with drag and drop.
escalation.sessionNotice: The escalation administration requires a valid sign-in.
escalation.forbiddenNotice: No permission for the escalation administration.
escalation.readOnly: Read only: changing requires the permission "Write settings".

stage.addInvalid: A key, both names and a position between 1 and 20 are required.
stage.removeHint: The stage leaves the chain; its rules are removed with it.

action.targetAssigned: The assigned technician of the ticket — the technician the escalation assigned it to, and the technician who accepted it himself after an offer.
action.notifyHint: The target receives the notification via ntfy; the channel selection is not used.

help.deadlines: The deadline is the waiting time in hours per priority. If it elapses without the condition matching, the rule does not fire.
help.stages: A stage is a workflow milestone (for example 'Review'). A rule connects a stage with a waiting time, a condition and the actions to perform.
help.chain: Every stage names its predecessor: its completion starts the waiting time. Without a predecessor the wait starts at the report. Stages can be added and removed; the rules of a removed stage leave with it.
help.reference: The start event starts the rule's waiting clock (for example 'Report received'). 'None' means: the rule waits for nothing and fires as soon as its condition matches.
help.timeline: The minutes are the waiting time of the stage per priority. The percentage belongs to the deadline rules only: 80 % and 100 % of the ticket deadline.
help.condition: The condition decides whether a rule fires. 'All' requires every leaf to match; 'any' is satisfied as soon as at least one matches.
help.actions: The actions run when the rule fires: a notification via the selected channels, a webhook delivery or a note in the ticket history.

errors.invalid_request: At least one value is invalid: a deadline must be between 1 and 8760 hours.
errors.stageChainInvalid: The stage chain is invalid: check the keys, the predecessor and the position.

transitions.emptyNotice: The workflow has no transitions: the ticket cannot change its status any more.

channels.hint: The notification channels of the installation. The environment is only a fallback; a stored value wins. A channel only counts as configured after its connection was confirmed with a code. Secrets are only written and never shown.

channels.readOnly: Read-only: you lack the notification.write permission.

verification.heading: Verify the ntfy connection
verification.hint: StörDesk sends a six-character code to the topic. Only after the code is entered here does ntfy count as configured and receive ticket notifications.
verification.stepSave: Save the address and the topic — the check always uses the stored values, not only the environment.
verification.stepSubscribe: Open the subscription below in the ntfy app or scan the QR code.
verification.stepCode: Send the code, read it in the app and enter it here.
verification.saveFirst: Save a reachable ntfy address and a topic first.
verification.testUsesSaved: The test message also sends to the stored configuration. Without a valid address and the right to publish, nothing arrives.
verification.personalLink: Personal subscription QR codes of the staff (Settings → Notifications)
verification.verified: Verified: the connection was confirmed with a code.
verification.sent: Code sent. It is valid until {{time}}.

errors.verification_code_invalid: The code is wrong or belongs to an older configuration.
errors.verification_code_expired: The code has expired. Please send a new one.
errors.verification_send_failed: The code could not be sent: {{reason}}
errors.channel_not_configured: ntfy is not fully configured. Save the address and the topic first.
The channel is not fully configured: save a URL and a topic first.
errors.no_token: The channel still misses its secret (bot token, access token …) — store it first.
errors.request_failed: The request to StörDesk failed (HTTP {{status}}, code {{code}}). Please pass the code on to support.
errors.http_error: The ntfy server answered with code {{code}}: check URL and topic and try again.
errors.http_401: Authentication required (401): the access token of this channel is missing or wrong — store it in the secret field of this card.
errors.http_403: Publication refused (403): most often the access token is missing or wrong — store it in the secret field of this card; only with a correct key it still has to be checked whether the topic is already claimed.
errors.http_407: Topic already taken (407): ntfy.sh only free or own topics — pick another topic.
errors.http_409: Rate limit reached (409): try again later.
errors.http_424: Message rejected (424): rate limit or invalid message.
errors.http_500: Internal server error (500): try again later.
errors.http_501: Not supported (501): use another ntfy server.
errors.http_400: Invalid request (400): check URL and topic.
errors.http_402: Payment required (402): ntfy may require ntfy.plus.
errors.http_404: Not found (404): check topic or server address.
errors.http_429: Too many requests (429): try again later.
errors.channel_unconfigured: Channel not configured: the ntfy channel is not enabled or not verified yet — configure and verify it first.
errors.http_timeout: No answer in time (timeout): the ntfy server never answered within ten seconds — check the address and the network; the row stays retryable.
